Romanian retail sales rise for the first time in a year

Retail volumes rose 0.9% year on year in August, the first increase after twelve months of decline. Food sales are still falling.

About

How we publish.

[ About this page ]

# What we publish here# How we write it# Corrections# Follow the news

News tip or correction

office@gdh-group.com

What we publish here

The industry news that matters to brands selling in Romania: retail and FMCG, store openings and new formats, market data, regulation that changes what can be listed, and the dental market. We pick the stories a brand owner, a chain buyer or a practice would want to know about, and post most working days.

How we write it

Every item is written by the GDH commercial desk in our own words and links to the original source, named at the top and the bottom of the page. We add a short note on what the news means for brands. We do not copy other publications’ articles, and the figures we quote are the ones the source published.

Corrections

If we have got something wrong, write to office@gdh-group.com with “Correction” in the subject line. We fix errors on the page itself and show the date of the update, rather than quietly changing the text.

Follow the news

Every item is also published in our RSS feed at gdh-group.com/news/feed.xml, which any feed reader can follow. There is no sign-up, no newsletter and no tracking: the site sets no cookies and runs no analytics.
